subject: Request: Hosted API pricing concession for Atlas Diagnostics
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasdx.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Victor Chen <v.chen@atlasdx.com>
Cc: Atlas Diagnostics Procurement <procurement@atlasdx.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — need competitive concession for pilot

Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our engineering team was impressed with the latency profile and prefix caching. We’re ready to move to a paid pilot but procurement is pushing back on list pricing. To get final sign-off we need a pricing concession for year one. High-level ask: 35% off hosted API usage pricing for the first 12 months with a 12-month committed minimum (projected 8–12B tokens/month).

We’ve attached our usage model so you can see the volume shape. Timeline is tight — procurement wants a signed MSA by Oct 15 to start onboarding before year-end. Can Redwood support a meaningful concession if we lock to a 12-month commit and agree to the standard SOC2 evidence request?

Attachments: Atlas_Projected_Usage.xlsx (spreadsheet)

— Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Integrations
Atlas Diagnostics
Samantha.Lee@atlasdx.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasdx.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 04 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need competitive concession for pilot

Samantha — really appreciate the transparency and the clear timeline. The volume profile looks strategic and we want Atlas to succeed. I’m looping in Ben (Deal Desk) and Laura (Finance) to request executive approval for a deep concession.

Proposed commercial structure I want to take to execs:
- 12-month committed term
- 25% off hosted API usage (year one) with monthly true-up against committed minimum
- Standard SOC2 + monthly token usage reporting
- Redwood onboarding credit ($50k) applied in month 1 to offset initial ramp costs

Asking for approval to offer 25% today as a firm concession. Ben/Laura — can you confirm if we have authority to go deeper or if this needs VP/C-suite sign-off? If we need to escalate, I’ll bundle the MOP, usage file and a short one-pager.

I’ve attached a draft MOP (MOP_v1.pdf) showing milestones and success criteria. Procurement: if that structure is acceptable, we’ll follow with the MSA redlines and DocuSign route.

Attachments: MOP_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasdx.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 04 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need competitive concession for pilot

Neha / Samantha — thanks for the context. Two quick items from Deal Desk perspective:
1) Margin note — 25% is a material concession but reasonable given 12mo commit and strategic nature; 35% is likely beyond delegated authority.
2) Alternative we can approve without exec escalation: 22% off + $75k onboarding credit + performance milestone rebate (additional 3% rebate if tokens >10B/mo for months 6–12). That keeps list hit and gives Atlas upside without immediate C-suite signoff.

If Atlas needs an immediate no-exec route, propose the 22% + $75k onboarding credit + milestone rebate. If Atlas prefers a clean single concession I’m ok supporting escalation for 25% (requires Laura sign-off).

Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

On Sat, Oct 4, 2026 at 11:03 AM neha_kapoor@redwood.com wrote:
> Samantha — really appreciate the transparency and the clear timeline. ...
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasdx.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need competitive concession for pilot

Team — I reviewed the ask and the projected usage. Before I can sign-off on any concession >20% I need:
- Simple 12-month ARR / expected revenue schedule (monthly billing run rate)
- Expected blended gross margin impact (approx %) with 25% concession and with the 22%+credit alternative
- Confirmation that SOC2 evidence will be provided within 30 days and that there are no data residency/legal constraints that would materially increase cost

Neha — can you send the ARR glidepath (monthly $) and confirm the final contracting owner on Atlas side (procurement contact). Ben — if you have a sensitivity table that shows margin impact by discount tier that would speed this up.

I’ll prioritize review once I have the numbers. If we decide 25% is strategic I can approve with a single finance-side condition: DocuSign-signed MSA + PO and receipt of SOC2 Type II attestation or written attestation timeline.

Laura Bennett
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasdx.com>, Atlas Diagnostics Procurement <procurement@atlasdx.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Oct 2026 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need competitive concession for pilot

Laura — thanks. Quick answers and attachments below:
- ARR glidepath attached (see tab "Revenue_Schedule"):  Month 1:$35k, M2:$125k, M3:$300k, ramp to $1.1M/mo by month 9 (12mo committed = $7.2M ARR equivalency on hosted usage pricing before discount)
- Margin sensitivity (attached) — with 25% concession gross margin impact is approx -14% relative to baseline; with 22%+ $75k credit impact is approx -11%
- SOC2: Atlas has confirmed they will accept our SOC2 Type II attestation and will provide PO within 10 business days pending pricing agreement (procurement contact is procurement@atlasdx.com)

We are asking for a one-time approval for 25% off hosted API usage for 12 months conditioned on signed MSA + PO and delivery of SOC2 attestation within 30 days. I’ve attached the updated MOP and a redlines summary for the MSA (MSA_redlines.docx).

Attachments: Atlas_Projected_Usage.xlsx, MOP_v1.pdf, MSA_redlines.docx

Please advise — timeline: procurement needs final commercial terms by Oct 15 to meet onboarding date.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasdx.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Atlas Diagnostics — 25% concession (conditional)

Neha / Ben / Samantha — approved. I will authorize a one-time 25% discount off hosted API usage for the first 12 months under the following conditions (must be met before any discount is invoiced):
1) Signed MSA via DocuSign and PO issued (DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/exec/ATDX-4893)
2) SOC2 Type II attestation received or firm delivery timeline documented in writing (<=30 days)
3) Account health check milestone at month 3 (operational ramp OK; tokens >= 50% of MOP projection or discount term review)

Ben — please update HubSpot (Deal ATDX-4893) to reflect final pricing and include the margin sensitivity file. Neha — you can share the DocuSign link with procurement and move forward once MSA/PO are in place.

This approval is limited to the Hosted API usage line item and does not extend to marketplace or third-party pass-through fees.

Laura Bennett
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
